optimization_evidence: Authors report improved transparency after partial fructose substitution by sucrose, and the largest benefit from increasing thioglycerol. scope:

Derived deliverables exclude original full text, original figures and complete source blocks.

Note.Text11:
limitations:
White matter and heavily myelinated regions retain greater opacity; macroscopic clearing of several-millimeter blocks does not establish microscopic imaging through the full block.

Note.Text12:
limitations:
Human DiI evidence comes from one described39-year-old male donor. Body-donor group count/ages are not reported.

Note.Text13:
limitations:
PLP amygdala versus formalin neocortex comparison confounds fixation with region, tissue source and preservation history. The apparent improvement is descriptive, not an isolated causal fixation-effect estimate.

Note.Text14:
limitations:
No normalized pre/post fluorescence intensity assay, fluorescence retention percentage, long-term post-clearing stability assay or measured photobleaching curve is supplied.

Note.Text15:
limitations:
Sudan Black B shows lipid detectability after clearing, without lipid mass balance or a quantitative retention fraction. Author language about majority preserved is stronger than the quantitative assay coverage.

Note.Text16:
limitations:
Statistical comparison uses18 ROI observations per condition nested in6 samples; accounting for nesting and donor counts is not described.

Note.Text17:
limitations:
Exact group mean imaging depths and SEM are not printed numerically; no graph digitization performed.

Note.Text18:
limitations:
Supplementary Fig2 image panels have independently adjusted brightness and contrast and cannot be used to measure depth-intensity decay.

Note.Text19:
limitations:
Human dataset uses single-view deconvolution. Dual-view deconvolution, accurate whole-network tracing and MASH counterstaining are proposed future work, not completed validations.

Note.Text20:
limitations:
Peripheral imaging aberrations and uncertain dendritic spine identity are acknowledged; blebbing/tissue degradation cannot be excluded.

Note.Text21:
limitations:
The study contains figure numbering, panel mapping, scale and timing inconsistencies. These are retained in source_conflicts rather than silently repaired.
